Subject: [UAI] Final Call for Participation ACM IUI-2008 - 12th Int. Conf. on Intelligent User Interfaces (January 13-16, 2008, Maspalomas, Canary Islands)

Final Call for Participation ACM IUI-2008 - 12th Int. Conf. on Intelligent User Interfaces
January 13-16, 2008, Maspalomas, Canary Islands
http://www.iuiconf.org/

********************************************************************

Early registration deadline ends: December 17, 2007
Book accomodation now! Canary Islands is a favorite holiday spot in January!
Registration now open: http://www.iuiconf.org/registration.html

********************************************************************

Invited Talks:
  Theodore W. Berger: US: Implantable Biomimetic Electronics as Neural Prostheses for Lost Memory Function
  Enrico Motta, UK: Exploiting large scale Web semantics to build end user applications

********************************************************************

Come and visit the presentation of selected papers from over 220 submitted short and long papers
30 selected full papers in the main programme (22% selection rate)
32 short papers in the main conference poster session
9 selected demonstrations in the main conference poster session
More at http://www.iuiconf.org/08program.html

********************************************************************

Attend state-of-the-art tutorials:
T1: Joemon M Jose, U of Glasgow: Adaptive and Context-Sensitive Information Retrieval Systems
T2: Martin Dzbor, OU: Semantic Web for Computer and Users?
More at: http://www.iuiconf.org/08tutorials.html

********************************************************************

Attend one of 6 workshops:
W1: Enculturating Conversational Interfaces by Socio-cultural Aspects of Communication [full day]
W2: International Workshop on IUI for Ambient Assisted Living (IUI4AAL 2008) [full day]
W3: Intelligent User Interfaces for Developing Regions   [full day]
W4: 5th International workshop on Ubiquitous User Modeling [half day]
W5: Recommendation and Collaboration (ReColl)   [full day]
W6: Common Sense Knowledge and Goal-Oriented Interfaces (CSKGOI 2008) [half day]

********************************************************************

Registration now open: http://www.iuiconf.org/registration.html


Pearl Pu
EPFL, Switzerland
Publicity Chair for IUI'08
